entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE (substitute, BCAA axis). The dietary logic in BCKDK deficiency (high protein plus BCAA supplementation) is the reverse of maple syrup urine disease, where BCAAs are restricted, because the amino acids are depleted rather than accumulated; this is a class contrast, not a statement about WWOX.
entries.snippet: Unlike MSUD, where BCAAs must be strictly restricted, BCKDK deficiency requires a high‐protein diet and BCAA supplementation [3, 9].

experimental_context.endpoint: plasma BCAA, head circumference, motor function, autism occurrence
